description: PMH-S-600 is a single component moisture curing silane-modified polyether (Modified Silicone) sealant. It is non-toxic and odorless. It is free of isocyanates, solvent, formaldehyde and toluene. It combines the strong adhesion characteristics of polyurethane with the weather resistance of silicone, making it suitable for demanding underground waterproofing applications.
whereToUse: Pile head penetrations and pipe through concrete walls
Interface sealing between metal components and concrete
Junctions between base slab and retaining wall
advantages: Good tolerance to slightly damp substrates
Low shrinkage during curing, reducing interface cracking risk
Compatible with membrane and coating waterproofing system
notFor: Read the product label and Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) before using it
Protect all materials from extreme temperature
storage: Store in a dry and cool place to avoid exposure. Storage temperature 5-30°C. Warranty period - 12 months.
